data.name: Fareea
data.gender_notes: Fareea is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'farara', meaning to be free, release or liberate. The name Fareea symbolizes light, radiance, and freedom. It is also a variation of the name Fatima, which means 'the one who is free from all imperfections'. The name Fareea carries the meaning “Light, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fareea usually hope their child will grow to embody light, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes spiritual enlightenment and freedom from worldly attachments.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fareea total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
